result.title: How to know if an image is AI generated or not
result.description:
Is this real… or is this AI?

As AI-generated images, videos, audio, and text become part of our daily lives, distinguishing them from other media is more important than ever. In this video, we show you how to use our SynthID and C2PA Content Credentials tools to learn more about the content you consume. 

You can also refer to this article to stay in the know about SynthID and C2PA: https://goo.gle/4yGjrTe

result.title: How Gemini 3.6 Flash helped this dairy farmer run his business
result.description:
Dairy farming is a highly complex biological system driven by unpredictable market forces. In this video, see how Paul, a Michigan dairy farmer uses Gemini 3.6 Flash in Google Antigravity to build an AI dashboard that automates daily performance tracking. Gemini Flash cuts token costs while combining vision and reasoning to automate farm financial calculations from photos alone, freeing up time for hands-on work without sacrificing operational insights.
